# elves_configuration (Data Source)

Looks up a configuration by its name, for example the default configuration or one created in the UI, to get the ID that `elves_config_rule` needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "elves_configuration" "default" {
  name = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Required. Exact name of the configuration, as shown on the Elves Configurations page.

### Read-Only

- `client_mode` (String) `MONITOR` or `LOCKDOWN`.
- `id` (Number) ID of the configuration in Elves.
- `sync_type` (String) `CLEAN_ALL`, `CLEAN` or `NORMAL`.
